title: Dialogue graph
description: A conversation as a graph of nodes. Each node shows text and offers choices. Choices may be gated by conditions, wrapped in skill checks, and may apply effects and route to other nodes.

speakerId.description: default character speaking in this dialogue

replayable.description: true if the player can re-enter this dialogue after first completion; once-only choices (showIf flag gates) will simply not appear

offer.description: Self-declared candidacy for being OFFERED to the player (presented on approach, or discovered as a continuation). The PRESENCE of this object is the opt-in — a dialogue without it is never a candidate and is reached only by goto/entersDialogue/route/world placement. Resolution gathers a character's offers, drops those whose when fails (and visited non-replayable ones), and picks by priority tier, then condition specificity (leaf 1, all sum, any min, not operand), then ordinal id. Replaces the character dialogues ladder.

character.description: The character this dialogue is offered BY, when that is not its speakerId (e.g. a narrated protagonist trial). Defaults to speakerId.

when.description: Gate. Absent = the fallback (specificity 0), offered whenever nothing more specific or higher-tier is eligible.

priority.description: Priority TIER, compared before specificity (default 0). A higher tier beats every lower-tier candidate however specific. Forced routing uses a tier-1 offer gated on active_dialogue__{character}.

entry.description: id of the node where this dialogue begins

speakerId.description: overrides the dialogue's default speaker for this line — a character or skill id; omit for narration

text.description: The line shown at this node. Optional ONLY on a node with non-empty 'choices' (a text-less choice node presents just its options); every other node must carry it — enforced by the validator (FLOW), since a schema-level conditional would reject valid nodes here.

onEnter.description: effects applied when this node is reached

showIf.description: Optional gate on this node's DISPLAY. On an interstitial node (one with 'next', no choices, not isEnd) a failed gate SKIPS the node: resolution continues at 'next', its text is not shown and its onEnter effects DO NOT fire; such a node requires 'next', and a 'next' chain must terminate at a node with no showIf. On a node with 'choices' or 'isEnd' a failed gate hides only the LINE: the node is still reached, its choices are still offered (or the dialogue still ends) and its onEnter effects still fire — the step reports textHidden. A showIf on a node with no text is an error either way (nothing to hide).

isEnd.description: true if this node ends the conversation

next.description: choiceless advance to another node id in this same dialogue, for listen-only beats. Mutually exclusive with a non-empty 'choices' and with isEnd — enforced by the validator (FLOW), not expressible here since additionalProperties:false plus all-optional fields makes a schema-level oneOf reject valid nodes.

showIf.description: choice is hidden unless this condition passes

goto.description: next node id (omit if check provides onSuccess/onFailure, or if choice ends convo)

fallback.description: true: this choice is offered ONLY when no non-fallback choice on the node is visible (its own showIf, if any, must still pass) — Ink's '* ->', Yarn's fallthrough. A node with an ungated fallback can never strand the player, so the validator drops its 'may be stuck' warning; more than one fallback, or a fallback beside no gated sibling, is a warning.

whenLocked.description: What the player sees when this choice's showIf FAILS. 'hide' (the engine default, overridable by rules.choices.whenLockedDefault) drops it from the step entirely; 'show' returns it in stepDialogue's lockedChoices so the engine can present it greyed out. It is never selectable either way.

lockedText.description: Optional replacement text for a choice presented locked (whenLocked 'show'), e.g. '[Requires Engineering 3]'. Localizable, never voiced. Omit to show the choice's own text.

tags.description: Opaque per-choice labels (e.g. 'mood:angry'). Pass-through: the runtime returns them on the visible choice and never reads them.

portrait.description: Portrait registry id for this node only, overriding the speaking character's default portrait — for projects that author per-line expressions. Omit to use the character's own portrait.

notes.description: Author-only annotation. Never shown to the player; ignored by the runtime.

tags.description: Opaque per-line labels (e.g. 'mood:angry', 'sfx:door') an engine hangs animation, audio or camera work off. Pass-through: the runtime returns them on the step's node and never reads them; no validator rule reads them either.
